name: Figma
description: Figma's remote MCP server gives the agent design context it cannot get from a screenshot: frames, components, variables and styles from the files you allow. Sign-in is Figma's own OAuth consent, and the file access follows your account.

probe.note: Answers 405 with a JSON-RPC 'Method not allowed' body, so the endpoint is alive but refuses GET; the OAuth requirement is documented by Figma, not observed here.
